rule.description: A function embeds a near-complete, identifier-renamed copy of the body of another still-defined function: a single maximal parametric token window between the two bodies spans at least 90 canonical tokens and at least 80% of the helper's body tokens, with at most 8 bijective identifier substitutions; every non-identifier token must match exactly.

checks.description: Detect a driver function that carries the implementation body of a still-defined shared helper, pasted in under renamed local identifiers.
checks.detected_relation: owner function -> embedded near-complete body copy of still-defined helper h
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The driver performs the helper's step inline instead of delegating to it, so the sub-method implementation lives in two places and the driver's abstraction levels are collapsed.

matches.evidence: A copy of the section-pair correlation helper (kpatch_correlate_section, still defined in the same file for its other call sites) is embedded in the section correlation stage, using cloned locals cs_orig/cs_patched bound to the enclosing loop's section pair.

The output-finalization loop embeds the body of the still-defined rela-section data rebuild helper (kpatch_rebuild_rela_section_data), re-creating the rela buffer inline through a local alias of the loop's rela section.

The exported-symbol fallback stage embeds the body of the still-defined exported-symbol lookup helper (lookup_exported_symbol, also used by the exported-symbol probe), renamed in its loop variables (ei/esym) and read through the name local.

Both cleanup passes (arch-specific sections and intermediate .kpatch sections) embed the body of the still-defined section removal helper (kpatch_remove_and_free_section), each through a secname local taken from its section-name array.
The dynrela section construction embeds the body of the still-defined single-section allocation helper (create_section), reached through the nr_pair rename and a computed expressed-size local.
Same as above owner: the dynrela output loop embeds a second near-verbatim copy of the rela-section data rebuild helper (kpatch_rebuild_rela_section_data) over the rela section it just filled.

excluded.description: Copies of absorbed helpers whose defining functions no longer exist (comparison chain, per-scope lookup stages, static-local twin search, klp find-or-add stages, dynrela pair-body tail) and copied fragments shorter than 90 tokens or below the 80% ratio (the rela-half of the dynrela section-pair allocation) are not reported by this rule: they are fragments of removed functions whose restoration requires re-creating the missing definitions.
excluded.relation: owner function -> embedded fragment with no still-defined counterpart
